introduction: **S1.1 — the five layers of the work / agents / authority / skills / context / routing layer, and their precedence (F2, 2026-09-13).** The nine logical components above are unchanged and no tenth is added. What the F2 round settles is **which question each part of that layer decides, and which decision governs when two disagree**. Named plainly: **consequence class decides who may act; a declared procedure decides how the work runs and what each step may see; a typed standing interest decides when work becomes due; an existence record decides whether a worker may be created at all; and exactly one standing party exists for each duty that outlives the case carrying it.**
precedence: **Precedence is fixed and operative: the lower-numbered layer governs when two disagree.** Class may **raise** what a procedure permits and never lower it. An interest may arm but never admit above its effect class. An existence record may refuse a worker the class would permit but never create one the class forbids. A holder may hold but never act. **Why a layering rather than one organizing unit:** the round established that there is **no single unit of justification** — the founder's five criteria predicate on five different objects, and a criterion applied to the wrong unit returns undecidable, which reads as satisfied. Each of the five candidate designs carried its worst blocking findings on **its own routing unit**, so a synthesis that picked one unit would have inherited that unit's blind spot. Layering the units and stating which governs does not. The five criteria themselves are judged in [the F2 selection record](F2/05-selection-record.md) §2: **distinct tools or permissions** confirmed and the strongest of the five, **isolated context** refined and split into an attention sense and a confidentiality sense with only the latter justifying a worker, **independent verification** refined with half of it unreachable inside one model family, **parallel work** refined to near-inert at the current concurrency pin, and **specialized knowledge overturned** as a reason to create a worker.

items.name: L1 · consequence class
items.governing_rule: Every action carries the **set** of routing classes it reaches, computed by one deterministic function from records the acting party cannot author, recomputed at release on the frozen bytes; **every reached class's gates apply** and no rank is computed

rule_sections.heading: 11. Consequence class and the layer contract
rule_sections.text:
**SPECIFICATION — new in WORK-1.1. This section states layer 1 (R-L1) and the precedence rule; §1 introduces them and this section is where they bind.**

**Every action carries the set of routing classes it reaches.** The set is computed by **one deterministic function** from four inputs and no others: the **resolved parameters**; the **destination and egress identity**; the **selector closure** over conflict claims, deletion scopes and open obligations; and the **owning capability contract's declared floor**. **Every reached class's gates apply.** No total rank exists, **no seventh class is added**, and **no severity score is computed** — this restates [`02-authority-recovery.md`](02-authority-recovery.md) §4, which already heads its table *"Routing classes are predicates, not a total privilege rank"*, and it changes nothing there. The gate evaluator consumes the **set**; a future implementer who reintroduces a rank drops C2's human requirement on an action that is both C2 and C3, which is the observed failure (AT-M4-02, disposed in [the selection record](../F2/05-selection-record.md) §5.2). **No monotonicity proof is owed, because no ordering is used** (R-D22).

**`ConsequenceDerivation` is the record of the derivation.** Identity `(operation_intent_ref, derivation_fn_version, derived_at)`; lifecycle `computed → recomputed_at_release → matched | parked_on_mismatch`; **sole writer: the release path**; **append-only**. `mismatch_disposition` is writable only by the party owning the park. **The class is recomputed inside the ordered release transaction, on the frozen bytes, and a mismatch parks and never resolves downward.**

**There is exactly one implementation of the derivation.** Two implementations of risk classification disagree, and you find out during the incident — observed directly in this repository, where a second, stricter classifier in a workflow file demanded a tier the one classifier did not compute. The function, the mapping table, the holder set and every declared floor are **C5 protected control changes** requiring independent authorization, with **no model in the acceptance path** (see [`08-improvement-implementation.md`](08-improvement-implementation.md) §1).

**Precedence, stated operatively.** Lower-numbered layers govern. **Class may raise what a procedure permits and never lower it.** **An interest may arm but never admit above its effect class.** **An existence record may refuse a worker the class would permit, but never create one the class forbids.** **A holder may hold but never act.**

**What "carries a promise" means, and why it is not computed from a draft (R-D21).** Whether an outward artifact carries a promise is **not computable from any of the four permitted derivation inputs**, and a non-model step that recognised an obligation inside a draft would put a judgement inside the class derivation that this layer's own rule forbids. It is therefore **floored by the capability**: CAP-13, CAP-14, CAP-15 and CAP-16 floor at the economic/contractual class. **UNKNOWN — founder-owned parameter (selection record §6.2, MD-21):** which capabilities carry the floor. The stated default is **all four**; narrowing the set is a throughput trade and it is the founder's, because it decides how much outward drafting needs a person.

**The model provider is a named C2 disclosure destination (R-D12).** It carries a standing `DisclosureContract`, and the loader's class-narrowed projection **is** the destination-clean construction that [`02-authority-recovery.md`](02-authority-recovery.md) §8.2 already admits — so a model call is a **pre-authorised C2 release gated by projection conformance**, not a C04 transaction per turn. Amending that contract is a C5 change. **The "model calls are exempt" branch is refused**: exemption would have relaxed a fixed boundary, and taking a construction the boundary already admits does not.

**Approval expiry and the accumulated set are themselves C5.** The derivation function, the mapping table, the standing-holder set and the declared floors are C5 (above). So is the **accumulated approval set**, which is the object an executor's own record never shows: each approval is individually small and the ratchet lives only in their sum, which is why R-X18's expiry and the monotonic-exposure diff over **effects releasable without a human** are stated here and not left to review.

**Removal criterion for layer 1, in falsifier form (R-X26).** Layer 1 is removed when **more than 90% of admitted actions derive to the two lowest classes over a fixed window** — then the added structure is not paid for. **Or** when **the derivation and the declared floor agree on every action over a window**, in which case the derivation adds nothing the floor already said and the floor alone survives. Both need only the derivation function and a month of admitted work, which makes this the most executable falsifier this chapter carries, and it is aimed at this layer's own foundation.

rule_sections.heading: 3. Workflow, run and step execution
rule_sections.text:
**SPECIFICATION — amended in WORK-1.1; no record is renamed and no record is added here.** `WorkflowDefinition` is an immutable versioned procedure: typed input/output ports, named steps, deterministic guards, allowed adaptive branches, stage rules, maximum elapsed/idle time, retry/compensation contracts, evidence and acceptance roles. **`WorkflowDefinition` and `StepExecution` additionally carry six declared fields** (R-L2, [selection record](../F2/05-selection-record.md) §12.3's changed-records list): `step_kind ∈ {compute, model, human, professional, effect}`; `declared_read_set`; `declared_grants`; `validator_ref`; `branch_set`; and `critical_fields`. These are **fields on the existing registry records** — the candidate-era proposal to rename these records to `Procedure`/`Step`/`Journal` is refused (R-X02, closing AT-M3-02), and the alias table of [`11-schemas-state-contracts.md`](11-schemas-state-contracts.md) maps every candidate name to its registry name so that no candidate-era name is ever admitted as a record name. A fixed path handles known repeatable work; an adaptive step produces a proposed next plan under the same scope and allowance. The admission owner chooses the mode using uncertainty and cost evidence, not whether the producer prefers more freedom. Unknown cases leave the fixed path through an owned exception; they do not silently bypass gates.

**SPECIFICATION.** `WorkflowRun` pins definition, Case, causal episode, exact inputs and current step cursor. `StepExecution` pins step definition and WorkOrder; its execution projection follows the canonical order/report/acceptance records. A run follows `prepared/running/waiting/parked/acceptance_pending/accepted/failed/cancelled`. A step follows `ready/dispatched/running/reported/accepted/rejected/waiting/cancelled`. Only C02 advances the cursor, in the same protected transaction that records the step result and creates the next work intent. C06 judgment plus the required sponsor acceptance permits a run's accepted state. Actual effect states remain OperationStatus dimensions.

**SPECIFICATION — amended in WORK-1.1.** Each step declares an input contract, performer class, read/write resource scope, result envelope, allowed outcomes, exit predicate and next branch. **The loader delivers the step's `declared_read_set` and records what it actually delivered; the caller's claimed read list is not trusted** — the same rule [`06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md`](06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md) §2 already states for context assembly, now made a property of every step. This is what converts *"the checker did not read the producer's rationale"* from an assertion into a manifest fact, and a design in which a worker assembles its own context cannot make that claim at all. **A guard is a pure function over typed outputs and journal state; a model's output is an input to a guard and never a jump** — control flow is trusted, model output is data, and the published utility price of that separation is paid deliberately (R2 F-09). **One effect per effect step, and the step is the idempotency unit**: on resume after an interrupt the whole step restarts, so a human approval step that shared its node with the payment it approved could duplicate that payment (R3 F29, F30). **The step boundary is the checkpoint** (R-D19): every step boundary is a close-out point and the cost is carried, so no separate reserved-closing-allowance predicate exists — the alternative needed a denominator the round establishes does not exist (AT-M1-03). Deterministic transformations execute without a model. Nondeterministic model/tool/human results are captured once as attributable data; replay consumes the recorded result only while current validity permits it. A live regeneration is a new attempt, never “replay.” External operations are proposed and released through C04, outside database transactions. Domain acceptance can require an actual professional result or customer condition; a successful dispatch does not satisfy that guard.

**SPECIFICATION.** Stage is an epistemic/business position such as proposed, investigated, validated, deliverable or maintaining. Status is whether execution is running, blocked or finished. Workflow definitions choose relevant stages; they do not impose a coding pipeline on finance or support. A small deterministic correction can use one production step and one required acceptance check. A declared guard may establish that a stage is inapplicable, with a reason; current authority, data permission, required review and actual duty-discharge predicates cannot be skipped. New contrary evidence can move the current projection backward through a recorded invalidation/review decision, preserving earlier acceptance history.

**SPECIFICATION.** Changing a definition creates a new revision. Existing runs remain pinned if compatible and safe. A migration plan names in-flight states, old/new step mapping, preserved outputs/unknown effects, invalidated acceptance, current grants and rollback. C02 parks incompatible runs, and C04/C08 fence affected authority where required. Resuming from the middle requires exact accepted checkpoint, available inputs, compatible code/definition and current restrictions. The system does not replay a payment or customer contact to reconstruct a cursor.

**SPECIFICATION.** Compensation is its own typed work with authority and acceptance. It may repair a consequence while leaving history and obligations. Steps declare `no_compensation`, an actual compensating procedure, or a need for a competent decision. A failed refund, apology or supplier replacement remains an owned duty; cancelling the workflow never makes those results true. Integration tests must inspect the combined journey after individually correct steps.

**SPECIFICATION — the zero-allowance step kind, and maximising its share.** `step_kind: compute` consumes no model allowance. Determinism is the only lever that cuts subscription consumption without cutting work, so raising the `compute` share of a procedure is a first-class design goal of every procedure admission, and the share is reported per procedure version.

**SPECIFICATION — procedure admission refuses a model-selected acceptance strength (R-X19, closing AS-M3-01).** A `branch_set` in which a **model-authored typed value selects between acceptance strengths** for one artifact is refused at admission, naming the failed predicate. Acceptance-strength selection is a guard over journal state and consequence class, never a producer's choice: typing the checker's *inputs* does not help if the producer still picks the *checker*. A model step may supply a typed value into a declared field of declared type and domain, and that is the whole of what it may do to control flow.

**SPECIFICATION — a producing run may not select its own checker.** The checker's procedure comes from committed configuration, not from the producing run. A routing component that can choose who checks its own work has not achieved procedural independence.

**SPECIFICATION — the adaptive envelope has a named author (R-X04, closing AT-M3-04).** An adaptive step's envelope is authored by the **capability owner at procedure admission**, never by the resuming or adapting attempt. The envelope of `unclassified-work/v1` is written out rather than left implied: step kinds `{compute, model, human}`; read set = the work record plus its cited sources; **effect classes = none**; one launch per step; and a declared maximum step count. A procedure whose adaptive envelope is unstated is not admissible.

**SPECIFICATION — one parameter, not two (R-X05, closing AT-M3-05).** The collapse threshold (when an adaptive procedure collapses to a fixed path) and the retirement window (when that procedure version retires) are **one parameter with one owner** — the capability owner — declared per procedure at admission. Two numbers for one concept is what produced the finding; they cannot be set independently.

**SPECIFICATION — `unclassified-work/v1` has a clock somebody owns.** Work admitted under it carries a **declared maximum age**, and a breach of that age is **itself admitted work** with an owner, not a log line. Unknown work is therefore neither dropped nor parked forever.

**SPECIFICATION — a drafted procedure is not an executable one.** A procedure drafted by a model becomes executable only after a passing test suite **and** a human capability owner's acceptance. A control-flow structure authored by a model from untrusted input is precisely the thing the trust boundary exists to prevent (R3 F11). **A declared grant is resolved against the grant policy at admission**, so a declaration no configuration backs is refused rather than carried — the decorative-declaration loophole, observed in this repository as 44 capability declarations that nothing backed (R3 F57, F60). **The grant policy is not a new object, and naming it is the point (F6D-06): `declared_grants` is `Ref<Grant>[]` and is `required` on both `WorkflowDefinition` and `StepExecution`, and the registry of `Grant` records — issued by C04, each carrying issuer mandate, holder, purpose, destinations, bounds and expiry — is the policy it resolves against.** A second grant-policy record would be a second authority over one question, and two implementations of one rule disagree at the moment it matters. **Resolution is a conjunct on the admission edge** — `guard.grant.declared_resolves_to_live_grant` — and **the step is refused, naming the failed predicate, when a declared grant does not resolve to a live `Grant` held by the step's executing identity and no wider than what the step declares**; the paired benign case is a step whose declared grants all resolve, which must not be refused. **It is a typed ref and not bounded text**, because free text is the decorative form of this same declaration: a string cannot be resolved against anything, and `validator_ref` on the same record was already a typed ref, so the typed form was available and unused. **Arrival is a different fact from scope**: `GrantDeliveryReceipt` and `grant_arrival_attested` (§4) attest that a grant arrived, never that it was the right one, and this rule is the half that checks scope.

**SPECIFICATION — permissions do not compose; they decompose.** Three permissions needed by one task become **three effect steps**, and the union grant never exists anywhere. This answers [the F2 acceptance protocol](../F2/00-acceptance-protocol.md) §5 item 6 — whether a composite grant is minted, borrowed or refused — with **refused, not minted**.

**SPECIFICATION — removal criteria for the L2 additions, in falsifier form (R-X26).** The declared read set and the step model are removed when **a newer model passes every step's declared validator with the step merged into its neighbour or removed**. The precedent runs against its own authors' interest and is why the criterion is stated rather than assumed: a scaffold's contribution is a function of the model generation that motivated it and must be re-ablated when the model changes. The `critical_fields` marking is removed when, over a window, no resumed attempt's behaviour differs with the marking present or absent.

**SPECIFICATION — what marks a field critical, and who marks it (R-D18).** A field is critical if a `ParameterAuthority` governs it, if it is a `ConstraintSet` member, or if the procedure declares it in `critical_fields`. The marking authority is the **capability owner at procedure admission** — never the resuming attempt, which is the party with an interest in the answer.

items.governing_rule: Relevance is a **computed, unstoppable armed set** over typed fields after every committed transition; **no precondition may invoke a model**; all prerequisites simultaneously, unexpired, uncontradicted, at or above their trust class

rule_sections.heading: 7. Durable schedules and capacity gaps
rule_sections.text:
**SPECIFICATION.** `Schedule` binds an accepted workflow/capability version, actual timezone/calendar rule, activation interval, occurrence window, latest responsible start, catch-up/concurrency policy, authority, resource class, sponsor and alternate. The initial scheduler is the kernel's durable SQL timer sweep plus event-triggered wakeups; no model runs merely to notice time. `ScheduleOccurrence` identity is schedule revision plus intended local/calendar occurrence and resolved UTC instant. The timezone-rule version and ambiguous/nonexistent local-time policy are explicit. A clock jump cannot create a second logical occurrence.

**SPECIFICATION.** Every schedule chooses one missed-occurrence policy. **Individual reconciliation** preserves each due invoice, service occurrence or reporting duty and its actual deadline. **Coalesce** produces one current research/maintenance assessment with the omitted windows listed; it cannot merge distinct rights. **Skip-expired** discards obsolete promotional opportunities with a reason and no catch-up blast. **Escalate** activates the accepted custodian/alternate when a missed action needs actual competent judgment. Defaults offered by procedure kind must be explicitly adopted; the software does not invent statutory deadlines or customer agreement terms.

**SPECIFICATION.** Occurrence states are `planned/due/admitted/running/completed/missed/disposed`; completion follows actual workflow acceptance. Missing work is not automatically marked completed when the next occurrence starts. The scheduling owner records what was intended, actual wake/start, lateness, duplicates suppressed, partial work and remaining duty. Concurrency defaults forbid overlapping instances of the same effect-bearing occurrence; independent read-only assessment can overlap only under separate input/resource admission.

**SPECIFICATION.** Unattended work needs all prerequisites in standing mandates, available context/tools, finite budgets, acceptance and no-answer/continuity behavior before starting. Attended mode does not weaken authority or allow unavailable service. When the company has no due or authorized useful work, executors idle; planned discovery runs only within its adopted mandate. During a gap, surviving local work can checkpoint through D1, due service uses actually available independent routes, and unavailable performance remains an operational failure. Return presents the human account's actual changes, missing periods and unresolved consequences.

**SPECIFICATION — `StandingInterest` and the armed set, new in WORK-1.1 (R-L3).** `StandingInterest` has identity `(id, version)` and lifecycle `proposed → trial → admitted → suspended → retired`; the **maintenance custodian proposes and the capability owner admits**. `ArmedSet` has identity `(journal_position)`, is a **computed projection with no lifecycle, and nobody writes it**. **Relevance is computed, and the armed set is unstoppable**: it is evaluated by deterministic code over typed fields after **every committed transition**, and **no component may prevent membership** — in particular, the admission authority holds no write access to any precondition-bearing kind. This is what makes a deferral a **visible state with a latest responsible time** rather than an absence indistinguishable from an oversight, which is the defect S1.0 carries because nothing exists until the case authority admits it (R5-01, R5-02). *Amended 2026-09-15 (F6D-08): on a derived projection `owner_component` names the **custodian** and not a writer — `ArmedSet.owner_component` is `S1-C02` in [`contracts/record-registry.json`](contracts/record-registry.json), whose `ArmedSet.owner_assignment` states that on a derived projection the field names the custodian and never a writer — so the invariant above and that value read as consistent rather than as the admission authority holding the write access this sentence denies it.*

**SPECIFICATION — the hard rules of layer 3.** **No precondition may invoke a model.** A model-evaluated gate is a model-placed boundary, which cannot hold, and determinism is the only free lever on capacity (AG-08; R4 F4, F6; R8 B-7). **An interest arms only when every declared prerequisite holds simultaneously, unexpired, uncontradicted, and at or above its required trust class** — the all-prerequisites shape, not a single-prerequisite trigger (R3 F33, D-15). **Trust class gates what an entry may activate and is never a weight on a ranking**: provenance-weighted ranking was indistinguishable from no defence at its shipped weight and took evidence recall to exactly zero at the weight that worked (R1 F-10). **The armed set is recomputed, never carried in a summary**, so a pre-reset summary that omits a decision cannot cause the wrong activation — the summary is not what activates. **A standing interest may write only a `proposed` revision of a constraint** (R-D23); `proposed → endorsed` remains C01's. **A proposal declaring a writer key is refused, naming the failed predicate** (R-D16): writer keys are assigned only by the record authority, and a trial may write only into kinds whose writer is already "any activation". **`proposed → trial` is admissible only at the two lowest effect classes**; read-only and internal-artifact capabilities proceed on an **expiring bounded trial** under a standing mandate while approval is pending, and outward-draft and outward-release require a human approver (R-G11). **UNKNOWN — founder packet MD-03 (selection record §6.5):** who that human approver is, its ceiling, and what happens during a founder absence. No default is invented; until it is answered, outward classes have no approver and therefore do not proceed.

**SPECIFICATION — admission is bounded to five verbs and five prohibitions.** The verbs are **admit, defer, shed, refuse, rank**. Among the prohibitions, the one that binds hardest is that **the admitter may not accept work it admitted**; the ordered custody resolver of [`03-company-capabilities.md`](03-company-capabilities.md) therefore **skips the admitting identity and continues to the next tier, recording `custody_tie_break_reason = admitter_excluded`** (R-X06). The admission authority gains one refusal predicate it lacked: **a per-origin arming rate** (R-X21). A single origin that can arm interests without bound is a disturbance loop, and the evaluation protocol for that predicate is stated here rather than cited elsewhere — baseline the per-origin arming rate over a declared window, unit is armings per origin per window, repetition is every window, the stopping rule is two consecutive windows above the declared rate, and the owner is C02.

**SPECIFICATION — the unmatched pool, and its residue named.** `UnmatchedPoolEntry` has identity `(work_record_ref)` and lifecycle `landed → claimed | refused | escalated`, written by the pool interest **deterministically**. It is the **computable complement** of the armed set: whatever armed no interest lands in it. **Retention exceeds the longest plausible outage** and **an alarm on arrival has a named reader**. **And the residue is stated rather than implied: the pool cannot catch an entry that armed the *wrong* interest.** A catch-all that does not name what it cannot catch is decoration (R5-09). **Removal criterion for layer 3, in falsifier form:** over one month, if **every item whose relevance nobody currently holds in mind is surfaced within its latest responsible time by the world-change sweep specified in the next paragraph**, arming buys nothing and is removed. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6A-02): the comparator read “**the existing scheduled review**”, which named nothing — no scheduled review is specified in this chapter or in [`02-authority-recovery.md`](02-authority-recovery.md), where the string “scheduled review” occurs zero times (checked 2026-09-14).* **Or** if the deterministic-predicate fraction falls below the threshold set under R-X25, layer 3 is **withdrawn rather than relaxed** — relaxing it for even one precondition class would reintroduce the model-placed boundary the layer exists to avoid. **UNKNOWN — founder parameter, no default (R-X25):** the value of that threshold. The measurement itself — the fraction of the company's conditions expressible as deterministic typed predicates — is owed with a baseline, a unit, a stopping rule and an owner, and it is cheap and unrun.

**SPECIFICATION — the world-change sweep, new 2026-09-14 (F6A-02).** The armed set is computed over committed transitions and `UnmatchedPoolEntry` is its complement over work records, so **an external state change that writes no transition and produces no work record neither arms nor lands in the pool** — a jurisdictional policy change is the worked case, and it is a second residue beside the one this section already names. **The entry path for such work is a named periodic sweep in this chapter, not a review assumed to exist elsewhere.** A `Schedule` whose accepted capability version is the **world-change sweep** runs under this section's ordinary rules: **owner C02**, which holds the schedule and its alternate; **missed-occurrence policy `individual reconciliation`** — never `coalesce` and never `skip-expired`, because an external change that looks obsolete is exactly what this sweep exists not to discard; and a **latest responsible start of one occurrence per review period**, the period §12 prices holder review over. Each occurrence enumerates the company's declared external dependencies — jurisdiction, provider terms, professional obligations and counterparty agreements — and **writes a work record for every change it finds, which is what returns the item to the armed set's reach**. A sweep that finds nothing **records that it found nothing**; an occurrence that does not run is `missed` and is itself admitted work, never a silent skip. **UNKNOWN — founder parameter, no default:** the review-period length this shares with §12, and who performs the enumeration where the dependency is a professional obligation (MD-02).

**DESIGN PROPOSAL — the protocol that would test the sweep, stated as the (c)-class hypothesis it is (F6A-02).** The claim *a periodic sweep surfaces world-change work within its latest responsible time* carries no evidence, and naming a sweep does not supply any. **Protocol:** a **planted-item probe** — a party outside the sweep's producing path records, out of band and before the window opens, a dated set of external changes that did occur in it; the sweep's output is compared against that set after the window closes. **Baseline:** the first full review period of ordinary operation. **Unit:** planted items surfaced within their latest responsible time as a fraction of planted items, reported beside the count of unplanted items the sweep surfaced, because a sweep that surfaces everything and a sweep that surfaces nothing both score well on one of those numbers alone. **Repetition:** every review period. **Stopping rule:** two consecutive periods at or above the declared threshold retire the probe; one period below it **withdraws the sufficiency claim and reopens the layer-3 removal criterion that rests on it**. **UNKNOWN — founder parameter, no default:** the value of that threshold. **Owner:** the instrument custodian of [`06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md`](06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md) §5, excluded from every producing path — **not C02**, which owns the sweep and may not grade itself. The probe is authored and frozen **before** the period it grades, under §12's ordering rule: a case authored once the result is known is void.

**SPECIFICATION — the metered-affordance observer.** A `credit-setting` interest **observes the metered affordance and halts new launches in that class when it flips**, and it is disclosed as **observation, not prevention**: the metered path is one account setting away at both providers and nothing currently observes it. The observation point, cadence, named reader and response live in [`07-integrations-capacity.md`](07-integrations-capacity.md) §5, and the flip is priced there as a **capacity** event as well as a money and policy one.

**SPECIFICATION — a sample of what was refused is returned (`refusal-sample`), inside an encounter kind that already exists.** A bounded sample of work the system declined is returned to the founder **as the adverse stratum of the first of [`04-human-operation.md`](04-human-operation.md)'s four encounter kinds — original customer material, which already alternates ordinary with adverse, abandoned and underserved cases** — on that chapter's existing cycle, inside its declared batch minutes, drawn by its existing sampling rule: a reproducible recorded random seed within strata, outside the account producer's write authority, with empty strata recorded rather than replaced by flattering examples. **A refusal nobody reviews is a decision nobody made**, and a job the company declined is the underserved case that stratum exists for. **It takes places in that stratum rather than adding places**, and the competition is visible because the sampling record already states what was drawn and which strata were empty. **This adds no encounter kind, no cadence and no counted line to `04`'s attention admission, so it is not a third delta to that chapter's FIXED competence mechanism** (F6A-03). The test is written out so a reader can check it rather than take it: if `refusal-sample` required a slot of its own, a cadence of its own, or an attention line of its own, it would be a delta and would need a decision packet under [DIRECTIVE §3](../../inputs/DIRECTIVE.md); it requires none of the three. *Superseded 2026-09-14: this paragraph read "returned to the founder on the participation cycle of `04-human-operation.md`" and named no encounter kind. `04` §3 declares **exactly two deltas** against the competence mechanism and calls any further delta a decision packet, so a construction riding the cycle without naming where it rides was a third delta on one reading and a coherence defect on the other. The disposition taken here is to keep `04` fixed and route the sample through a kind it already has.*

**SPECIFICATION — the unretirable `grievance` interest.** The `grievance` interest may not be retired. It composes with the closure interlock of §12: **closure cannot complete until the grievance holder's duties are transferred to an accepted custodian**, because a closure with an unowned redress route is a broken promise recorded as a clean end.

**SPECIFICATION — capacity rules this section adds to [`07-integrations-capacity.md`](07-integrations-capacity.md) §6.** **Capacity is carried on the fields that already exist, and this amendment adds no `budget` field.** An object that consumes capacity is bounded by the `allowance` on its `CausalEpisode` and by its own `reservation_refs`, both **required** today in [the record schema](contracts/records.schema.json), and `CapacityState` — the registry name is `CapacityObservation`, through [`11`'s alias table](11-schemas-state-contracts.md) — records **remaining-or-unknown structurally rather than by assurance**: its `measurement` is a `MeasuredQuantity`, which is `{knowledge: observed, quantity, evidence_refs}` **exclusive-or** `{knowledge: unknown, reason, held_maximum}`, so an unknown allowance **cannot be written as a number** and writing it unknown forces a reason and a held maximum. *Superseded 2026-09-14: this read “**`budget` is a mandatory schema field on every object that consumes capacity**”. **Zero of 188 records declared a field whose name begins `budget` and zero required one**, so the sentence was itself the decorative declaration §3 refuses two sections earlier — a declaration no configuration backs (F6A-08, F6D-10). The `CapacityState` half was correct, is kept, and is now stated in terms of the field that carries it.* **A cross-class release happens at a declared lapse point** with a stated precedence for which class receives released capacity — due service, then continuity/security/grievance, then maintenance and evaluation, then ordinary creation, then discretionary — and the **quantity that lapsed unconsumed is recorded per lane per window**. That release is **independent of any holder's consent** (R-X24). **The exhaustion rule is distinct from the pressure rule** (R-G01): when the allowance is empty and a due obligation falls due, the **named non-model production mode** of `07` §6 performs it — carried by the required `Obligation.production_mode` and its `production_performer_ref`, with an obligation in an exhaustible duty class whose mode is `none` refused at admission (F6C-01) — a named recipient is alerted, and the breach-or-perform decision leaves a record naming which was chosen and why: **`ExhaustionDecision`**, written once per `(obligation_ref, window)`, C02 proposing and C01 authorising, and deliberately not a variant of `ShedDecision` (F6C-02) — *fifty percent of an empty bucket is zero* is the case that rule exists for. **The concurrency pin these lanes are sized against is itself unsettled — provider constraint or self-imposed policy is unknown — and the account inspection that settles it is the founder's, registered as [Q-022](../../registers/open-questions.json)** (F6C-07); §12's reserved-lane holder rests on a fixture that cannot be run until it is answered. **Evaluation carries a row of its own among [`07-integrations-capacity.md`](07-integrations-capacity.md) §6's enumerated planning shares — distinct from the maintenance row and not funded out of it** (R-X11, F6C-05) — and when the evaluation cycle collides with a pressure window **evaluation sheds at the maintenance tier's position in that section's release precedence, and the shed cycle is a recorded instrument gap, never a silent skip**. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6C-05): the row and the shed tier read as one fact here while `07` §6's only enumerated shares bundled evaluation into a single 10% maintenance/evaluation row — the bundling R-X11 forbids. They are two statements now: the row says what evaluation is funded from, the tier says when it yields.*

items.name: L4 · ExistenceJustification
items.governing_rule: One of six admitted reasons, the unit it predicates on, **a test that can return false**, the alternative, a removal criterion and an expected cost. Specialized knowledge refused; attributable identity mandatory and never a reason

rule_sections.heading: 4. Temporary workers, model choice and bounded reasoning
rule_sections.text:
**SPECIFICATION.** `AgentTemplate` is a versioned production recipe: supported capability contracts, input/output schemas, instruction and skill refs, runtime eligibility, tool/context requirements, bounds, self-checks and known limits. It is not an identity with standing. `AgentInstance` binds that recipe to one admitted WorkOrder, executor identity, runtime profile, lease epoch and generation. C02 can instantiate it under an existing mandate and allowance; creation does not add a new role to company governance. Stable parsing, arithmetic, timers, permissions and release remain deterministic procedures. Actual taste, specialist judgment and physical service remain with the legitimate people/services specified in company operation.

**SPECIFICATION.** A general model can use a domain skill when the needed competence has passed relevant tests. A specialist is selected only for a demonstrated task distinction, confidentiality boundary, real professional requirement or measured cost/quality benefit. A role gap appears as an unowned required outcome, repeated unsupported handoff, missing competence or unacceptable wait. The maintenance custodian proposes addition/replacement/removal; the legitimate capability owner approves the changed contract and C06 evaluates it. Retirement requires reassignment of remaining work and revocation of effective tools/sessions, not deletion of a name alone.

**SPECIFICATION.** `ExecutionSelection` records candidate runtime/agent/skill versions, eligibility reasons, observed performance limits, expected resource ranges and chosen fallback. Eligibility first checks purpose/data destinations, actual auth/billing, required tool boundary, output contract and task evidence. Among eligible qualified profiles, choose the least total expected cost that meets the specific acceptance constraints, reporting uncertainty. Provider/model names and leaderboard ranks alone cannot qualify a profile. If no profile has relevant evidence, use a bounded internal trial or a competent human route; consequential promises cannot assume the trial succeeds. **SOURCE CLAIM.** [N01](../../research/implementation/N01-native-execution.md) supplies native interface feasibility, not a universal best model or available quota.

**SPECIFICATION.** Reasoning has a visible `ReasoningPlan`: exact question, known observations, assumptions, rival hypotheses, next discriminator, limit and stop condition. More reasoning is justified when another bounded observation can change an important decision within its latest time; it is waste when it repeats an unchanged failure or cannot affect the action. A self-reported confidence is a claim, calibrated on relevant outcomes before numerical interpretation. Unknowns become owned KnowledgeQuestions. Conflicting instructions are resolved by authenticated authority, effective scope and current restrictions; retrieved content cannot outrank them. Conflicting legitimate values go to the actual deciding rule, while independent work proceeds.

**SPECIFICATION.** Producer self-checks are useful preparation, including running an exact test or inspecting a rendered output. They do not become independent acceptance. Approach failure is distinguished from execution failure by predeclared rival explanations and tests of the value proposition, including the option to stop the offer. A worker reports `capability_mismatch`, `missing_prerequisite`, `no_progress` or `unresolved_question` with evidence instead of claiming impossible after an arbitrary number of attempts.

**SPECIFICATION.** Trust is scoped eligibility, not a general score. New templates start with fixture/internal production scopes and no outward credentials. Increased autonomy requires observed conformance in the specific consequence/data domain, independent acceptance and an actual amended grant. A changed model/tool/skill, missed material defect, drift or invalidated prerequisite narrows eligibility immediately. Success never expands authority automatically. Workers can read authorized peers' work projections; they cannot see all company context merely to coordinate.

**SPECIFICATION — `ExistenceJustification`, new in WORK-1.1 (R-L4).** A model worker is created **only** against an `ExistenceJustification` record, identity one per `AgentInstance`, lifecycle `proposed → admitted → expired_with_instance`, sole writer **C02 at admission**. It names **exactly one** of six admitted reasons, the unit that reason predicates on, a **test that can return false**, the alternative considered, a removal criterion and an expected cost in [`07-integrations-capacity.md`](07-integrations-capacity.md) §6 units. `AgentInstance` gains `existence_justification_ref`. **The load-bearing transition is `proposed → admitted`, and it is refused if the decidable test cannot return false** — that is what makes the existence gate mechanical rather than rhetorical.

*Every row is SPECIFICATION.*

| Admitted reason | The unit it predicates on |
|---|---|
| Permission scope | a permission scope |
| Input provenance | an input set |
| Consequence class | an effect class |
| Confidentiality boundary | a context boundary |
| Named partition | a partition |
| Verification relation | a relation between two attempts |

**SPECIFICATION.** **Specialized knowledge is refused as a reason**, because it predicates on a **skill version** and not on a worker: across four model families, 162 roles and 2,410 questions, adding a persona gave no benefit and picking the best persona was no better than random ([R2 F-10](../../research/F2/R2-agent-existence.md), R6 F6, TC-33). **The disagreement R2 preserved is preserved here, on both halves** (F6B-10): ChatDev's ablation runs the other way — *"the most substantial impact on performance occurs when the roles of all agents are removed from their system prompts"*, Quality falling **0.3953 → 0.2212** — and F-10's reconciliation, that procedural content carries the benefit while the job title carries none, is **an INFERENCE and not a measured decomposition**, because neither study isolates the two. F-10 calls it *"the cleanest experiment nobody has run"*, and [the F2 acceptance protocol](../F2/00-acceptance-protocol.md) §7 requires the disagreement to be carried rather than resolved by the half that suits the design. A general worker loads a versioned, tested procedure instead (§8). **Attributable identity is mandatory for every worker and is never a reason**, since a property every worker must have cannot license creating one. **Provider or account separation is not a seventh reason; it folds into `ExecutionSelection`**, which already records candidate runtime/agent/skill versions and their eligibility. **The six reasons apply to model workers only.** The performer-type decision for people and professionals remains the five-way production rule of [`02-architecture-selection.md`](../02-architecture-selection.md) §3, because two of the six reasons do not transfer to a person at all and two reasons that apply only to people — professional standing the act itself requires, and being a differently-correlated error source — are not among them. Applying a criterion to a unit where it returns undecidable is the failure R2 F-20 names, and undecidable reads as satisfied.

**SPECIFICATION — removal criterion for `ExistenceJustification`, in falsifier form (R-X26).** It is removed when **at most five distinct worker shapes account for 90% or more of admitted work orders over one month** — [`02-architecture-selection.md`](../02-architecture-selection.md) §9 foundation 6's threshold and §8's layer-1 row, carried here by F6V-03 so that one observable carries one threshold and not two; **DESIGN PROPOSAL placeholder (F6C-17 / F6V-03): the five and the 90% are proposals, not measurements, and their owner is the founder** — or when **no admitted worker in a window names a reason other than permission scope** — in which case the six reasons are one reason with five unused branches and the record can be a grant check. The profile-convergence probe is run deliberately as a **pre-declared negative control against this design's own thesis**: count distinct worker profiles for one month, and if they converge, this design has a roster it discovered rather than declared. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6V-03): the removal trigger read "the distinct worker-profile count converges to a small stable set over a month", unquantified, while the reopen condition turning on the same probe carried a threshold. One observable had two thresholds, and the unquantified one is the **pre-declared negative control against this design's own thesis** — the control most likely to be read charitably by the party it judges.*

**SPECIFICATION — every approval carries an expiry (R-X18, closing AS-M2-02).** No approval of a template, grant, trial or capability is open-ended; each carries an expiry, and the accumulated approval set is re-read rather than assumed. The **monotonic-exposure check** diffs **effects releasable without a human** between two points in time — not the declared ceiling, which can stay fixed while the releasable set grows underneath it. A rising count with no corresponding decision is the autonomy ratchet, and it is visible only in that diff.

**SPECIFICATION — the grant must be observed to arrive, not assumed to (`GrantDeliveryReceipt`).** Identity `(agent_instance_id, first_effect_seq)`, written once, by **the enforcement point**. **An executor whose grant did not arrive fails loudly and never completes with less.** The rule this encodes is asymmetric on purpose: *assume a child holds no more than it was granted; never assume it holds what it was granted.* It exists because a delivery asymmetry was measured — an identical grant delivered **twenty-four tools on 2026-08-16 and zero across three independent dispatches on 2026-08-17, configuration unchanged**, cause unknown ([R3 F59](../../research/F2/R3-frameworks.md), X16). *Superseded 2026-09-14: this read “**two days later**”. It is one day. R3's own unknowns list says “two days later” while F59's body carries the dates, so the restatement copied the summary line and not the finding — which is AX-M1-03, the named instance of **AX-ROUND-01**, committed in the synthesis after being found in a candidate (F6B-09).* **AX-ROUND-01's own required contract is recorded here as owed, not as done:** the repository's existence-and-drift check exists, and its **existence** half runs over this tree and blocks in CI (`npm run check:citations-exist`, exit 0 on this commit); its **drift** half is WARN, is not a step of `npm run check`, and **this round has recorded no run of it over `research/F2/**` or `planning/F2/candidates/**`**. Owner: the instrument custodian of [`06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md`](06-knowledge-evidence-evaluation.md) §5, excluded from every producing path. Due before the next amendment of this chapter. **Removal criterion:** if across a window of dispatches every receipt records arrival equal to the grant, the receipt adds nothing and is dropped.

items.name: L5 · standing accountability
items.decides: who remains reachable after the work ends
items.governing_rule: A holder exists for a duty class **only** if its clock can run with no case admitted, an outsider has a right to reach the company about it, and it survives closure. It is a record — address, mandate, reservation, alternate, suspension procedure, review date — and **never produces, never releases, never decides the matter it is the subject of, and carries no model memory**

rule_sections.heading: 12. Standing accountability
rule_sections.text:
**SPECIFICATION — new in WORK-1.1. This section states layer 5 (R-L5).**

**A standing holder exists for a duty class if and only if all three of these hold.** (1) **The duty's clock can run while no case is admitted.** (2) **An outside party has a right to reach the company about it.** (3) **The duty survives closure of the work that created it.** All three, or no holder. **A holder exercised by no frozen fixture is unjustified and is refused on sight** — which is the mechanical form of negative control 4, and the test the chartered-desk candidate failed on its own footing.

**DESIGN PROPOSAL — how a holder for a duty class no frozen fixture exercises is admitted, and it does not require membership in a set frozen on 2026-09-13 (F6A-01).** The sentence above stands: a holder exercised by nothing is unjustified. What changes is that **the exercising case need not be one of the six fixtures frozen with [the protocol](../F2/00-acceptance-protocol.md)**, because §2's middle band can reach a duty class those six do not cover, and a holder set that can only shrink leaves that band permanently on the default custodian. A proposed holder is admitted when **all five** of these hold. (1) The three-part conjunction above holds for its duty class. (2) **A paired conformance case is authored under §9's rules** — an adverse case that must fail and its benign twin that must pass — and §9's pairing rule binds it: both numbers are reported or neither is. (3) The case is **authored and frozen before the proposed holder is staffed and before it holds any duty**, which is what keeps negative control 10 satisfied — a case authored once a candidate's result is known is void, and it is the **ordering**, not the age of the fixture set, that makes the growth path safe. (4) **The capability owner admits it and C01 endorses**, the same authority pair that writes every other `StandingHolder`. (5) The case is recorded as an amendment in [the protocol's amendment table](../F2/00-acceptance-protocol-amendments.md) in the form AM-01 already uses — date, round state, amendment, source requirement, reason — so a reader can see which cases were added after the freeze and when. `StandingHolder`'s required `exercising_fixture_id` then resolves to that case, which is what makes this mechanical rather than rhetorical. **The fixture set may therefore grow, and only through this path.** A holder proposed with no paired case, or with a case authored after it was staffed, is refused on sight as before. **Removal criterion, in falsifier form:** if over two consecutive review periods every holder admitted through this path retires unexercised, the path is admitting holders the company does not need and it closes, leaving the six.


**`StandingHolder` is a record, not a memory.** Identity `holder_id`; lifecycle `proposed → staffed → suspended → retired_into(holder_id)`; written by the **capability owner, C01-endorsed**. It is **an address, a mandate, a reservation, an alternate, a suspension procedure, a review date and its `capability_refs`** — and nothing else. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6W-01): the enumeration closed before `capability_refs`, which R-X07 below requires every standing structure to publish, so the record's own “nothing else” refused the field the coverage rule turns on. What this clause exists to prohibit is carried model memory and accumulated state; a pointer to the capabilities the holder is accountable for is neither, and it is written by the same authority that writes the record.* **`staffed → retired_into` is refused while any duty it holds is live.** **`* → suspended` stops admission in that duty class** rather than leaving work assigned and silent.

**The prohibition set, and it is the load-bearing half.** A holder **never produces**, **never releases**, **never decides the matter it is the subject of**, and **carries no model memory**. Carried model memory is refused as a property of a standing party because it is **the central claim in the round with zero supporting evidence**, and the two most-cited deployments refuse to support it — 14 failures, 3 inconclusive and 3 successes over 20 tasks in one, a reversal and a rehiring in the other (R8 A-7). **What is separable, and is kept, is reachability**: a party an outsider can reach **by name**, without knowing the company's internal topology. Reachability is not a consequence of memory or of reservation, and it is the property CAP-42 is carried by.

**"A holder prepares" means an ephemeral worker (R-X03).** When a holder's duty requires production, the work is performed by **an ephemeral worker instantiated under the holder's mandate, carrying the holder's reservation ref and intake address and nothing else of the holder's.** The performer is ephemeral per contact; the holder is the record that persists.

**A charter never vetoes.** A holder **may negotiate, never veto; may not refuse admission narrowing; and may not defend its own mandate.** Its **pre-declared shed minimum** — a level declared in advance, never invented under pressure — is what makes its answer **evidence rather than negotiation**. **The holder's stated minimum is evidence, not consent**, and **reserved-but-unconsumed allowance lapses at the reset independently of the holder's consent**, because a reservation under a non-rolling allowance is priced as **waste, not thrift**. Four protected holders that could each refuse a shed can hold an empty bucket hostage with no override anywhere (AE-M4-01, disposed as `rejected-with-candidate`).

**SPECIFICATION — an admitted standing acceptance-owner role is a record (R-X09), and after 2026-09-14 that set is three roles, not 46.** Each admitted standing role carries a reachability route, a capacity reservation, an alternate and a review date; **admission in that duty class stops while it is unfilled** (§2, R-D09). **The set it quantifies over is the one the founder's answer leaves standing** — **CAP-22, CAP-42, and CAP-31 on its day-five arm only** (the DECISION below) — **plus any of the six flagged candidates later admitted** through the five-part path, each on a paired conformance case frozen before staffing. **The 32 that dissolve are not records under this rule:** they enter the ordinary per-case acceptance step — an `AcceptanceInterval` and C06 acceptance of §5, opened when a case is open and not before — and R-X09's stop does not reach them, because there is no unfilled office to stop on. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-02): this read "**Every acceptance-owner role is a record (R-X09).** Each carries a reachability route, a capacity reservation, an alternate and a review date; **admission in that duty class stops while it is unfilled** (§2, R-D09)." It was written for all 46 acceptance-owner roles without distinguishing which of them meet R-L5's own conjunction, and the strict re-run of 2026-09-14 named this exact sentence as the thing the answer changes. Left standing, it sat 26 lines above the sentence narrowing it and quantified over the same set in the opposite direction: an implementer reading top-down builds 46 offices with 46 admission stops, one reading the DECISION below builds three. R-D09's stop halts intake in a duty class, so the difference is between a company that can take work and one that cannot.* Holder review is **priced, and the price is produced in the three paragraphs below rather than promised (F6A-12)**: a review-period length, an estimated holder-hours-per-period figure **with its denominator**, and a stated behaviour when holder review collides with a capacity-pressure window. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6A-12): this sentence stated the requirement and stopped. No such figure appeared in `05`, `02`, `04` or `07`, and `02` §8 repeats the requirement as one of two unpriced items — “which is the discipline the workflow-first candidate stated and did not apply to itself.”* **Intake sub-caps preserve intake (R-X17):** every published intake carries a **per-counterparty and per-origin-channel sub-cap**, and cap exhaustion **overflows to a named destination with an alarm and a reader** rather than refusing the next legitimate complainant — a full cap at the one object whose purpose is guaranteed reachability is the worst possible place for a refusal.

**SPECIFICATION — the capability binding is per capability and never grouped, and every standing structure that owns a capability's acceptance publishes its `capability_refs` (R-X07, landing in the specification 2026-09-14, F6W-01).** `capability_refs` — `Ref<Capability>[]`, **required and non-empty** — is carried by `StandingHolder` and by every acceptance-owner role record, written by the authority that writes the record. **SPECIFICATION — that set is closed and named rather than open: the standing structures R-X07 reaches are exactly `StandingHolder` and the acceptance-owner role record.** `StandingInterest` (§7) is **out of scope**: it decides when work becomes due, may arm but never admit, and binds no capability's acceptance, so it publishes no `capability_refs` and its absence is not a coverage hole. A new member enters this set only by being a structure that owns a capability's acceptance, admitted through §12's five-part path. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-09): the heading quantified over "every standing structure" while this body named two record kinds, and a third record whose name begins "Standing" is specified in §7. A coverage check written from the heading over-reaches and one written from the body may under-reach a structure added later, so the closure is stated here rather than left to the reader to guess.* **The binding is per capability:** a structure naming several capabilities in one row is **refused at admission**, never read as covering each of them, so coverage is counted over the 46 capability ids individually and never over groups. **No column rule excludes a row from coverage**, and **a chapter link is not an operative answer for a capability** — a capability no structure names is uncovered, not covered by default. **Why the rule is written here rather than cited:** [the F2 selection record](../F2/05-selection-record.md) states R-X07, records AC-M1-04 and AC-M5-01 as repaired by it, and rests its whole-company-scope retention on it, while AD-021's `epistemic_basis` recorded — correctly at the time it was written, and no longer — that "R-X07, cited by this record, DID NOT LAND … neither the string R-X07, nor `capability_refs`, nor the per-capability-never-grouped rule appears anywhere under the specification directory". **That state ended with this paragraph's own landing on 2026-09-14 (F6W-01):** at this commit the string R-X07, `capability_refs` and the per-capability-never-grouped rule all appear under the specification directory, placed there by the paragraph you are reading. **OWED, and the prose lane cannot make it:** AD-021's `epistemic_basis` in [`registers/decisions.json`](../../registers/decisions.json) still carries that sentence verbatim and still closes "That coverage discipline is carried by the F2 selection record alone, and is recorded here as outstanding, not as specified" — **it is stale as of 2026-09-14 and is owed a corresponding update from whoever owns the register.** *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6Z-04): this read "records — correctly — that", a present-tense claim of accuracy inside the paragraph that falsified it, pointing a reader at a register entry as current corroboration for a state the same paragraph had ended.* Two consolidation findings stood recorded as repaired by a rule an implementer reading the specification would never meet, and a coverage discipline is enforceable only where the binding is specified. **Still owed and not claimed here:** registering `capability_refs` on the record shapes under `contracts/**` is the contracts lane's work and has not landed, so this rule is **specified and unregistered**, which is its honest status.

**DESIGN PROPOSAL — the holder-review price and its denominator (F6A-12).** Every number here that the package does not already state is a **placeholder owned by the founder**, marked as such; none is a measurement. **The review period is four participation cycles, twenty declared operating days.** The five-day cycle is stated — [`04-human-operation.md`](04-human-operation.md) §107's default is **one cycle per five declared operating days, within the chosen minutes** — and the **four** is a **DESIGN PROPOSAL placeholder (F6A-12), owner founder**. **The denominator is a count of records and is stated before the figure, because an hours-per-period number without one is unreadable:** **46 capabilities, 46 distinct named acceptance roles, 41 of the 46 carrying `human` among their production modes**, plus this section's **four** layer-5 holders, **one alternate per layer-5 holder** — `StandingHolder`'s own field list in this section requires an alternate, so each of the four carries an alternate record of its own — and, under R-X09, **one alternate per acceptance-owner role** (F6W-02). Automation cannot reduce that denominator below 41 while 41 of 46 carry `human`. **Per-record review time is m minutes; m = 10 is a DESIGN PROPOSAL placeholder (F6A-12), owner founder**, and is not measured. **SPECIFICATION — the four layer-5 holders are the current floor of this denominator, not a closed set (F6W-02):** the admission path above admits a holder for a duty class no frozen fixture exercises, on a paired conformance case authored and frozen before staffing, so the holder term rises with each admission and falls only through the removal criterion. A denominator that states a fixed term under a rule which grows it reads as a bound when it is a floor.

**DESIGN PROPOSAL — both branches of [Q-017](../../registers/open-questions.json) (MD-02), with the arithmetic, and the packet stays open (F6A-12).** **Branch A — Q-017 answers “nobody but the founder.”** The denominator is 46 roles + 46 alternates + 4 holders + **4 holder alternates** = **100 records on one party**: 100 × 10 min = **1,000 minutes = 16.67 hours per period**, i.e. **4.17 hours per participation cycle**, against §105's `maximum decision-batch minutes`, which is a container carrying no value. **The arithmetic is not this branch's binding objection — the word *alternate* is**: a party that is its own alternate is one point of failure recorded as two. **Branch B — Q-017 answers “n of the 46 are staffed by a person other than the founder.”** The figure is **[2n + 2h] × m** minutes per period distributed over those parties and **[2(46 − n) + 2(4 − h)] × m** on the founder, h being the number of layer-5 holders staffed by a party other than the founder — every term is a role-and-alternate pair, and the two terms sum to **100m at every n and h**, which is the check the previous expression failed (F6W-03); and **admission stops in each of the 46 − n unstaffed duty classes** (R-X09, §2/R-D09), so admitted work falls with the review load rather than independently of it. At **n = 0 and h = 0** branch B is branch A exactly — [2 × 46 + 2 × 4] × m = 100m = **1,000 minutes**, the branch-A figure above; at **n = 46 with h = 0** the founder's load is the four holders and their alternates alone, [0 + 8] × m = **80 minutes**; at **n = 46 and h = 4** it is **zero**, and no record on this branch is his. **UNKNOWN — n, h and m are stated nowhere in this package.** Q-017 is **Answered (2026-09-14)** — the decision is below, and **this paragraph prices the branches rather than answering them**. Read the two together: the answer fixes the standing set at **three roles, all held by the founder**, so on the reduced list n = 0 and h = 0 and the branch-A arithmetic is the one that binds, over a denominator of 3 roles + 3 alternates + 4 holders + 4 holder alternates rather than 100 records; m remains unmeasured either way. *Amended 2026-09-14: this read “Q-017's status is `Open`, owner `founder`, `asked: null`; **this paragraph does not answer it and must not be read as having answered it**”. True when written and falsified the same day by the founder's answer, which is why the status is not restated here as a value — it is cited to the register.* [`02-architecture-selection.md`](../02-architecture-selection.md) §9 reopen condition 3 names this dynamic for layer 5's four holders only, not for the 46 acceptance-owner roles R-X09 creates. *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6W-02): branch A read “46 roles + 46 alternates + 4 holders = **96 records on one party**: 96 × 10 min = **960 minutes = 16.0 hours per period**”. It sourced alternates from R-X09 alone, which governs acceptance-owner roles, and so dropped the four holders' own alternates that `StandingHolder`'s field list requires in this same section. The one number F6A-12 asked this section to produce understated the founder's branch-A load by four records, and understatement is the flattering direction for a section whose subject is whether the founder can carry the design — the second ambiguity in this chapter to run that way, F6B-06 being the first.* *Amended 2026-09-14 (F6W-03): branch B's founder term read **2(46 − n) × m** and carried no holder component, so neither stated endpoint held — at n = 0 it gave 920 minutes against branch A's 960, and at n = 46 it gave zero where the sentence said “the four holders alone”, the holders sitting in the term said to be distributed over the other parties. No assignment of h could satisfy both endpoints, because no term in the founder's expression could ever contain a holder. This paragraph exists to price two branches so the founder can choose between them, so a reader who trusts the endpoints and a reader who evaluates the formula must not get different answers — the F6V-01 defect class, inside the paragraph that answers the founder-attention finding.*
